question: The southern part of India lies within the _________ zone.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **southern part of India** lies within the **Tropical zone.**
 
• The** areas of Earth that surround the equator **are known as the **tropics**.
 
 
• The **Tropic of Cancer** in the **Northern Hemisphere**, located at** 23°26′10.2° (or 23.43616°) N**, and the **Tropic of Capricorn** in the **Southern Hemisphere**, located at **23°26′10.2° (or 23.43616°) S**, define their latitude.
 
• The **tropical zone** and the** torrid zone** are other names for the tropics.
 
• The tropics constitute 39.8% of Earth's surface area and contain 36% of Earth's landmass.
 
 
 
• The Tropic of Cancer cuts India into two parts : Northern India and Southern India. The southern part comes under Tropical zone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The locations with mild temperatures that fall between the polar and subtropical zones are known as** temperate zones.**

 
 
• The term "temperate zones" refers to the two **areas between the Tropic of Cancer and the Arctic Circle** and the Tropic of Capricorn and the Antarctic Circle.
 
• The** south temperate zone** is located **between the Tropic of Capricorn at 23° 27′ S and the Antarctic Circle at 66° 33′ S.**
 
• The** north temperate zone** is located **between the Arctic Circle at 66° 33′ N and the Tropic of Cancer at 23° 27′ N**.
 
 
 
• The areas of Earth that round its geographic poles—the North and South Poles—and are contained inside the polar circles are known as the **polar regions**, sometimes known as the **frigid zones** or **polar zones.**
 
 
• The **Antarctic ice sheet**, which covers most of Antarctica and the Southern Ocean in the south, and the floating sea ice that covers much of the Arctic Ocean in the north are the main features of these high latitudes.
